visualCharacteristics.purpose: Two text columns (H3 + paragraph) in one rounded panel with a thin divider between them
visualCharacteristics.description: Two text columns (H3 + paragraph) inside a single tan rounded panel with a thin vertical divider between them, left-aligned inside a centered section. Neither columns-intro (section head, no panel) nor columns-media (text + photo) matches.

contentPattern.description: A fixed pair of different text items side by side in one panel that never wraps: Columns.

reuseGuidance: Use for a fixed pair of short text items shown together in one panel. Section heading above stays default content. For text beside a photo use columns-media.
